sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted and the sentence on counts 1 and 5 is reduced from twenty-two months to fifteen months.
note: Offences not stated; bail breach wrongly treated as aggravating.

offence_note: Sexual interference with a child; attempted extortion
sentence_quote: The appeal should be allowed and the sentence imposed by the sentencing judge for sexual interference restored.
note: SCC restores six years, up from four and a half years set by Court of Appeal; extortion six years concurrent.

offence_note: One second degree and three first degree murders

note: Life on all counts concurrent; 15 years on count 1, 25 years on counts 2-4, concurrent.

offence_note: Second degree murder of his wife
sentence_quote: He was sentenced to life imprisonment with no eligibility for parole until he has served 13 years.
note: Conviction and parole ineligibility appeals dismissed.

sentence_quote: on the charges of conspiracy to traffic in marihuana and cocaine (Counts 1 and 4 on the indictment), concurrent sentences of 8 years are imposed.
